evidence.description: The public state getter reads and sorts items without synchronization.
Change notifications read state on the main queue.
Downloaded items are assigned on the private dispatch queue.
needsUpdate also reads items outside the private queue.

candidates.explanation: Writes to items occur on the private queue, but reads occur on the main queue and directly through state and needsUpdate. The private queue does not synchronize these external reads with its writes, so the mutable Set can be accessed concurrently.
candidates.title: Unsynchronized access to shared mutable state

evidence.description: The network error is discarded, and decoding failures cause an unreported return.
Cache reading and decoding errors are suppressed with try?.
Persistence errors are swallowed by an empty catch block.

candidates.explanation: Network, decoding, cache-reading, and persistence failures are discarded without any error reporting or observable failure state. Callers and subscribers cannot distinguish these failures from an operation that simply produces no update, and persistence failures leave no diagnostic information.
candidates.title: Operational failures are silently discarded

evidence.description: The URLSession response is discarded, and the body is decoded without inspecting its HTTP status.
Any successfully decoded body is merged into items and scheduled for persistence.

candidates.explanation: A completed URLSession request can contain an unsuccessful HTTP response with body data. This code treats a decodable body as successful regardless of the response status, allowing a non-success response with a matching payload to update and persist news.
candidates.title: HTTP response status is not validated
